description: Lists the business cards the person received in swaps at an event, newest first, at most 50: first name, company, where and when they met, their LinkedIn link when the card has one, whether an email or phone exists (not the values), and a "we met at" `note`. The person sends each LinkedIn invitation themselves from the link. Needs a personal connector token. `myLinkedin` saves the person's own linkedin.com/in/ link on their card when it has none, in two steps: without `confirm` it returns a `confirmToken` and saves nothing; with confirm true and that token it saves.

confirm.description: With myLinkedin: absent saves nothing; true with confirmToken saves.

confirmToken.description: The token the first call returned.

eventIdOrSlug.description: Optional event id, slug or name; else the current event, else every swap.

myLinkedin.description: Optional own linkedin.com/in/ link; other shapes are refused.

name: event_card_links
title: My cards with LinkedIn links
